name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Bars grow in turn, then focus racks and the camera pushes in on the winner. A small gap between bars makes it a histogram.

props.name: label
props.doc: The button label (the export that makes the number).

props.name: title
props.doc: Small heading over the number in the finished chart.

props.name: value
props.doc: The stat, as written.

props.name: deltaLead
props.doc: Bold lead of the line after the stat, e.g. "5.8k".

props.name: delta
props.doc: The rest of that line.

props.name: series
props.doc: The two legend entries: last period, this period.

props.name: days
props.doc: X axis labels, spread evenly under the chart.

props.name: ticks
props.doc: Y axis labels, top to bottom.

props.name: cells
props.doc: The histogram, one string per row from the top: "#" a cell of this period, "." a cell of the last period, " " empty. Rows must be 52 wide.

props.name: settle
props.doc: Seconds the button spends settling from the press before the collapse starts (measured: the collapse starts at 0.4 s).

props.name: collapseAt
props.doc: Seconds when the label starts to dissolve and the pill to collapse.

props.name: collapseFor
props.doc: Seconds the collapse takes, ease-in: it arrives at full speed.

props.name: chartFor
props.doc: Seconds the chart takes to fade up around the square, starting as the square lands.

props.name: cutAt
props.doc: Seconds when the shot cuts out to the whole chart.

props.name: zoom
props.doc: Magnification of the close-up.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: Seconds the whole chart holds after the cut.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The colour of this period and of the button after it collapses.

props.name: accentTop
props.doc: A lighter accent, the top of each cell.

props.name: muted
props.doc: Last period cells.

props.name: color
props.doc: The button and the stat.

props.name: background
props.doc: Background.
